verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a financial platform like Airwallex, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export feature, open-format downloads (such as CSV or JSON statements), or an offboarding or portability path. The API and CLI read access (awx-supp-cli) and AgentOS cashflow reports are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented 'export all data and leave' capability, so they earn no credit.
